'''Iggjel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who was part of the [[Wayland Herd]].<ref name="Iggjel" /> Sometime before [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{CSWECite|II|80|Iggjel}} establishes that Iggjel was one of the Ithorian's first priests. ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which took place in [[3951 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', features [[Chodo Habat]], an earliest established Ithorian priest in the timeline. Therefore, it can be deduced that the story took place sometime before 3951 BBY.</ref> the [[tender]]-in-training felt the call of the [[Mother Jungle/Legends|Mother Jungle]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-spanning jungle of the Ithorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. Along with a [[Iggjel's friend|friend]], he boarded a [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] and flew out into the jungle, on the pretense of exploring new territory. After reaching a dense part of the jungle, Iggjel left his friend and broke sacred law by exiting the vessel and setting foot on the jungle floor.<ref name="Iggjel" /> Iggjel would go on to become one of the Ithorian's first priests.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|80|Iggjel}}</ref>
